title: The Story of Jonah

memoryVerse.text: God is with you wherever you go.

moral.lesson: Jonah tried to run away from God — he got on a ship going the opposite direction! But there was nowhere Jonah could go where God was not with him. God still loved Jonah, rescued him from the sea, and gave him a second chance.
moral.application: You can never go anywhere that God is not. Even when you make a wrong choice, God is still with you and always ready to give you another chance.

style: Flat-color children's cartoon storybook illustration, simple rounded shapes, soft warm colors, thick clean black outlines, bright and friendly, gentle lighting, 16:9 landscape composition, no text or words in the image, no letters.

beats.scene: Jonah, a man with a short brown beard wearing a rust-orange robe, stands outdoors on a sunny hillside looking uncertain and worried, with a warm glow of light from the sky above him.
text: God gave Jonah an important job. “Go to the big city of Nineveh,” God said.
“Tell the people there to stop doing wrong things.”
But Jonah did not want to go.

beats.scene: Jonah, the man with a short brown beard in a rust-orange robe, hurries up a wooden plank onto a sailing ship at a busy harbor, looking over his shoulder. Blue water and a bright sky.
text: So Jonah tried to run away from God.
He got on a ship sailing the opposite direction, far away from Nineveh.
But you can never run away from God.

beats.scene: A wooden sailing ship tosses on big rolling waves during a wild storm with dark clouds, wind, and rain. Frightened sailors hold onto the ship, and Jonah, the man with a short brown beard in a rust-orange robe, is among them.
text: Out at sea, God sent a great wind, and a huge storm shook the ship!
The sailors were terrified. Jonah knew the storm was because he had run away.
“Throw me into the sea,” Jonah told them, “and the water will calm down.”

beats.scene: A friendly cartoon view inside the belly of a great big whale: Jonah, the man with a short brown beard in a rust-orange robe, kneels praying with his hands together, with a soft warm glow of light around him. Gentle blue-green underwater tones, not scary.
text: As soon as Jonah went into the water, God sent a great big whale to swallow him up and keep him safe.
Jonah was inside the whale for three days and three nights.
There in the dark, Jonah prayed — and God heard him.

beats.scene: Jonah, the man with a short brown beard in a rust-orange robe, stands safely on a sunny sandy beach with the great big whale swimming away in the blue water behind him. He looks up thankfully at a bright warm sky, and a large city is visible in the distance.
text: God told the whale to put Jonah safely on dry land.
Then God said again, “Go to Nineveh.” This time Jonah went!
Jonah could not run away from God — because God is always with me.
